title: licence-activate-reply
description: POST /api/v1/licence/activate 200 reply (section 17.15). The same installId activating the same key again gets the same kind of reply (idempotent - a reinstall that kept its data, or a retry).

licenceToken.description: Signed token for THIS till: source portal, installCode = the request's installCode, onlineCheck required, and (since 2026-09-28) the shop's companyId/branchId, names and company block, maxRegisters = tills allowed in the branch, features (multi_branch), limits.branches, validFrom/expiresAt.

licence.description: Plain summary of the same fields (company block, maxRegisters, limits.branches, features, validFrom, expiresAt).
